scope: Proposition 13.13 (Forward proper projections) of the manuscript “Finite congruence lattices: characterization and undecidability” (preprints/Finite-Congruence-Lattices-Characterization-and-Undecidability-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 206 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d26d6cd6285de4f2), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 133. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In a forward realization [P, W]H, suppose P > 1 and c(P) < W. Every cut coatom is a product label. If P < c(P), its closure label has empty footprint and lies below J∗.
